articles.title: Google brings Gemini in Chrome to India
articles.summary: As part of the rollout, Gemini will support languages including Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Telugu, and Tamil.

articles.title: Amazon launches its healthcare AI assistant on its website and app

articles.title: AgentMail raises $6M to build an email service for AI agents
articles.summary: AgentMail provides an API platform that lets you give AI agents their own email inboxes, with support for two-way conversations, parsing, threading, labeling, searching, and replying.

articles.title: Meta acquired Moltbook, the AI agent social network that went viral because of fake posts

articles.title: Yann LeCun’s AMI Labs raises $1.03B to build world models
articles.summary: “My prediction is that ‘world models’ will be the next buzzword,” AMI Labs CEO Alexandre LeBrun told TechCrunch. “In six months, every company will call itself a world model to raise funding.”

articles.title: OpenAI and Google employees rush to Anthropic’s defense in DOD lawsuit
articles.summary: More than 30 OpenAI and Google DeepMind employees signed onto a statement supporting Anthropic's lawsuit against the Defense Department after the agency labeled the AI firm a supply-chain risk, according to court filings.

articles.title: Anthropic launches code review tool to check flood of AI-generated code
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Code Review in Claude Code, a multi-agent system that automatically analyzes AI-generated code, flags logic errors, and helps enterprise developers manage the growing volume of code produced with AI.

articles.summary: This deal underscores how frontier labs are scrambling to prove their technology can be used safely in critical business operations.

articles.summary: Anthropic filed suit against the Department of Defense on Monday after the agency labeled it a supply-chain risk. The complaint calls the DOD's actions "unprecedented and unlawful."

articles.summary: The company is slashing its Commerce site workforce to about 1,600, citing EV market conditions, as it pivots to stationary energy storage.

articles.summary: Shippers face legal risks, unclear timelines and system gaps as they navigate a potentially complex rollout of tariff refund procedures.

articles.title: Power and capital constraints may drive shift to modular cooling, smaller data centers
articles.summary: The wait for new large-scale data centers to connect to the power grid is approaching five years in major data center markets, according to a Feb. 26 report from JLL.

articles.title: Appeals court upholds California’s net metering 3.0
articles.summary: “Petitioners do not sufficiently describe the benefits of the tariff that the Commission purportedly failed to quantify,” the court said.

articles.title: NERC overstates reliability risks in long-term assessment: Grid Strategies
articles.summary: The North American Electric Reliability Corp’s analysis uses low generation and interregional power flow assumptions but a high demand forecast, including from data centers, the consulting firm said.

articles.title: Energy Star is moving to DOE. Industry groups are hopeful.
articles.summary: Both the Department of Energy and the Environmental Protection Agency, which currently runs the program, had big staff cuts last year. At least one group has questions about DOE’s plans.

articles.title: EPA properly awarded $1.5B of now-terminated grants, inspector general says
articles.summary: Among the 80 impacted awardees were dozens of energy projects, including energy efficient housing retrofits and weatherization, solar, storage, microgrid and workforce development programs.

articles.title: Arizona Corporation Commission ends state’s renewable energy standard
articles.summary: “The mandates are no longer needed and the costs are no longer justified,” the commission said.

articles.title: MISO, SPP eye 500-kV cross-border projects to bolster reliability, save money
articles.summary: The proposed interregional projects would increase transfer capacity across the southern seam between the Midcontinent Independent System Operator and the Southwest Power Pool.

articles.title: Contract signed for generic Polish BWRX-300 design
articles.summary: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy and Orlen Synthos Green Energy have signed an agreement to develop a detailed technical design of the BWRX-300 small modular reactor adapted to Polish regulations, safety standards and environmental conditions.

articles.title: NANO signs MoU exploring MMR deployment in UAE
articles.summary: NANO Nuclear Energy has signed a memorandum of understanding with Abu Dhabi-based EHC Investment LLC to explore the potential deployment of KRONOS micro modular reactors in the United Arab Emirates.

articles.title: Denison to proceed with Canada's first ISR uranium mine
articles.summary: Denison Mines Corp's Board of Directors has made the final investment decision to proceed with the construction of the Phoenix in-situ recovery uranium project in Saskatchewan, with site preparation and construction activities planned to start next month.

articles.title: Urenco to supply fuel for Deep Fission reactors
articles.summary: Deep Fission, which aims to place small modular reactors in boreholes a mile underground, has signed an agreement to purchase low-enriched uranium from Urenco USA to support demonstration and testing of its initial Gravity reactor, as well as early commercial operations.

articles.title: First concrete for Kaiga 5 & 6 in India approved
articles.summary: India's Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has given its consent for the first pour of concrete for Kaiga units 5 and 6 - which are both 700 MWe pressurised heavy water reactors.

articles.title: Agreement to build German nuclear fusion power plant
articles.summary: Munich-based Proxima Fusion has signed an agreement with the Free State of Bavaria, RWE, and Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics to construct the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant at the former Gundremmingen nuclear power plant site.

articles.title: New heat-resistant steel developed for BR-1200
articles.summary: Rosatom says a new austenitic steel has been developed for the primary circuit of the planned lead-cooled BR-1200 reactor where the operating temperature will be 500-600 degrees Celsius.

articles.title: Lloyd's Register approves hybrid powered ship design
articles.summary: UK-based classification society and professional advisory service Lloyd's Register has issued approval in principle to Australian ship design group Seatransport Pty Ltd for a concept of a hybrid nuclear-diesel powered ship.

articles.title: Lithuania assessing potential for BWRX-300 deployment
articles.summary: Poland's SGE, Ignalina Nuclear Power Plant operator Altra and GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to assess the potential for BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Lithuania.

articles.title: 'Transformative' research reactor mooted for Texas A&M
articles.summary: The Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station has signed an agreement with advanced small modular reactor company ZettaJoule to explore building a very-high temperature modular reactor that could attract USD1 billion in research funding.

articles.title: Potential sites identified for SMRs in Chernobyl exclusion zone
articles.summary: The State Agency of Ukraine for Exclusion Zone Management has said that sites by two long-abandoned villages have been identified as potential locations for future small modular reactors.

articles.title: Amazon and Meta agreements boost Vistra nuclear plants
articles.summary: Landmark power purchase agreements with companies including Amazon Web Services and Meta are supporting Vistra Corp's plans to relicense and uprate its nuclear plants - but the focus on uprates is likely to come after 2028, the company's CEO has said.

articles.title: IAEA: Nuclear diplomacy is hard, but never impossible
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has urged restraint following the military attacks in Iran and the Middle East, and said it is ready to play its part in finding a diplomatic solution.

articles.title: Largest module installed at second Lufeng unit
articles.summary: The CA20 module - measuring about 20 metres in length, 14 metres in width and with a height of 21 metres - has been hoisted into place at the second unit of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in Guangdong province.

articles.title: SRS to construct Romanian reactor research facilities
articles.summary: Newcleo subsidiary SRS Servizi di Ricerche e Sviluppo has been contracted by Romanian state-owned nuclear R&D coordination organisation RATEN to supply lead-cooled nuclear reactor research facilities.

articles.title: First concrete poured for new capacity at Kaiga in India
articles.summary: The first pouring of concrete marks the point at which a project becomes a nuclear power unit under construction - the aim is for the first new unit at the Kaiga nuclear power plant to achieve criticality in five years.

articles.title: Cameco and India sign new uranium supply agreement
articles.summary: Canada's Cameco has entered a long-term agreement to supply uranium ore concentrate to India's Department of Atomic Energy, for use in the country's fleet of nuclear reactors.

articles.title: Safety work planned for Chernobyl turbine hall
articles.summary: A contract has been signed for the development of detailed design documentation for work on parts of the turbine hall and deaerator stack that extend beyond the giant New Safe Confinement arch-shaped shelter which encloses the ruins of Chernobyl’s unit 4.

articles.title: KHNP, EMA to cooperate on Singapore SMR study
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has signed a memorandum of understanding with Singapore's Energy Market Authority to cooperate on civil nuclear energy, particularly small modular reactors.

articles.title: Fisher German lands Wylfa advisory contract
articles.summary: UK land and property consultancy Fisher German has secured a contract to provide Great British Energy - Nuclear with expert advice during the planning and delivery of its small modular reactor project at Wylfa on the island of Anglesey, North Wales.
